title: Available ledger balance changed
description:
This event occurs asynchronously when account balance changes due to any relevant account activity, such as credit or debit operations, which in turn impacts account limits. This event also occurs when blocking, unblocking, and transferring held funds.
Generated by: Block amount, Unblock held amount, Transfer held amount
More information: Hold funds

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Amount by which the transaction impacted the account limits.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Defines if the transaction will impact the limit positively (CREDIT) or negatively (DEBIT).

tracking_id.title: Tracking ID
tracking_id.description: Unique 36-character tracking ID of the transaction.

updated_at.title: Updated at
updated_at.description:
**Deprecated:** this field will be removed in a future version. Use `available_update_datetime` instead.

Timestamp when the limits were impacted in the local time zone of the platform database.

amount_consider.title: Amount considered in the transaction
amount_consider.description: Amount by which to consider evaluating the transaction. For example, if this value is 100, but the transaction also has some associated fees, the platform can consider only 100 of principal amount to evaluate this transaction.

available_credit_limit.title: Available credit limit
available_credit_limit.description: Initial available credit limit of the account.

available_installment_limit.title: Available installment limit
available_installment_limit.description: Amount available for installments in the credit account.

available_savings_account_limit.title: Available savings account limit
available_savings_account_limit.description: Available limit of the savings account.

available_update_datetime.title: Available update datetime
available_update_datetime.description: Timestamp when the limits were updated in the UTC 0 time zone.

available_withdraw_limit.title: Available withdrawal limit
available_withdraw_limit.description: Amount available for withdrawal in the credit account.

caller.title: Caller API
caller.description: API that called the Ledger API.

considers.title: Considers
considers.description: Limits that are considered for evaluation in the transaction.

impacts.title: Impacts
impacts.description: Limits that will be impacted in the transaction.

opposite_impacts.title: Opposite impacts
opposite_impacts.description: This field contains a list of limits that should be oppositely impacted in response to the `operation_type`. For instance, if a credit operation affects `AvailableCreditLimit`, the limits specified in this list will be debited to counterbalance the credit impact.

held_funds.title: Held funds
held_funds.description: Held funds on the account. Usually, but not always, this occurs due to a legal action.

additional_funds.title: Additional funds
additional_funds.description: Additional funds represents funds that can be used as supplementary when needed and are available to credit limit, held funds, or other funds.

max_credit_limit.title: Maximum credit limit
max_credit_limit.description: Maximum credit limit approved for this account. Usually granted by a credit analysis.

total_credit_limit.title: Total credit limit
total_credit_limit.description: Total credit limit as set by the user. This can be any value up to the max_credit_limit.

total_installment_credit_limit.title: Total installments credit limit
total_installment_credit_limit.description: Amount limit for installments in the credit account.

total_overdraft_limit.title: Overdraft limit
total_overdraft_limit.description: Maximum limit for overdraft spending on the savings account.

withdrawal_credit_limit.title: Withdrawal credit limit
withdrawal_credit_limit.description: Amount limit for withdrawal in credit programs. This value is calculated by multiplying total_credit_limit and Withdrawal limit percentage (defined for the program).

impact.description: List of limits that will be impacted by the transaction.

consider.description: List of limits that are considered for evaluation in the transaction.

currency_code.title: Currency code
currency_code.description: ISO-4217 alphabetic code (3 characters) for transaction currency.

currency_numeric_code.title: Currency numeric code
currency_numeric_code.description: ISO-4217 numeric code (3 digits) for transaction currency.

impact_accounts.title: Impact accounts
impact_accounts.description: Deprecated: this field will be removed in a future version. List of accounts additionally impacted by the transaction. This field is only present in the event payload when there are associated accounts in the operation. If the operation has no associated accounts, this field is omitted.

available_update_datetime.title: Available update datetime
available_update_datetime.description: Timestamp when the limits were updated (RFC3339) in UTC.
